narrative: 这是现代拍摄的默认选择。你选定一个焦距，站在某个位置，这套光学系统不会把灯光拍成椭圆形，也不会把车灯拉成一道道光条。
清晰度和可控性更容易把控，因为你不需要同时处理挤压、还原展开，以及柱面镜片带来的画面瑕疵。只有当那些瑕疵本身就是重点时，这才不是合适的工具。
如果这个节拍需要椭圆形高光和横向光晕，你想要的是变形宽银幕镜头（Anamorphic）。39:1这样的宽画幅比例依然可以实现：你可以裁切，或者使用大尺寸的传感器。
那只是球面镜头上的一种画幅比例，而不是一种转换。
how: 选择一支球面定焦或变焦镜头，以及一个站位。透视依然取决于摄影机的位置；24mm球面镜头不等于85mm球面镜头。
如果散景的形状很重要，就要考虑光圈叶片的构造：圆形光圈会产生圆形高光，多叶片光圈会产生多边形高光。后期不需要做还原展开处理。
提示词：Spherical prime on [Subject], round bokeh, rectilinear edges, clean modern capture, no anamorphic streak.
when: 当你想要可控性和清晰度、而不是挤压光学带来的浪漫感时使用它：大多数覆盖镜头、特效底板，以及任何必须干净拼接或追踪的画面。不要因为加了黑边，就把球面镜头拍摄的画面标成变形宽银幕。
vs: 变形宽银幕镜头会挤压画面，常常还会让高光变成椭圆形；50mm标准镜头是一个你常常会用球面结构来拍摄的焦距。
老式电影镜头（Vintage Cine Glass）可能是带着老式镀膜的球面镜头；“老式”本身不是一种挤压。鱼眼镜头是一种曲线投影的球面结构，或者一种专用的投影方式，但依然不是变形宽银幕。
examples_film: 除非制作方特别说明，否则大多数现代数字电影都是用球面镜头拍摄的。把这当作一个提醒：圆形的灯光、没有来自拍摄镜头本身的横向光晕、几何关系与定焦镜头的视野相符。
这种风格取决于站位和焦距，而不是一套光晕插件包。
mistakes: 最常被搞混的近邻是给一张圆形散景的画面贴上“变形宽银幕”的标签。破绽是遮幅黑边加圆形灯光，再加上随意添加的光晕。
解决办法：圆形散景，没有挤压，直线边缘，并明确指出具体的球面镜头焦距。

faq.a: 球面镜头以旋转对称的光学结构拍摄出不经挤压的画面。透过圆形光圈的高光会保持圆形，也不需要变形宽银幕式的还原展开处理。
球面镜头：不挤压，散景通常是圆形的，画面呈直线校正的视野。变形宽银幕镜头：拍摄时挤压画面，散景常呈椭圆形，常带有方向性光晕。把球面镜头画面裁成宽银幕比例，并不能让它变成变形宽银幕。
当你需要可控性、清晰度，或者干净的底板画面时，把它当作默认镜头使用。只有当挤压光学本身的瑕疵就是要表达的那句话时，才跳过它。

faq.q: How do I prompt spherical for AI image or video?
faq.a: 写：Spherical prime on [Subject], round bokeh, rectilinear edges, clean modern capture, no anamorphic streak。加上一个真实的焦距。禁止椭圆形散景和横向光晕。

narrative: This is default modern capture. You pick a focal length, you stand somewhere, and the optic does not ovalize lamps or streak headlights into bars.
Sharpness and control are easier to specify because you are not also managing squeeze, desqueeze, and cylindrical artifacts. It is the wrong tool only when those artifacts are the point.
If the beat needs oval highlights and horizontal flares, you wanted Anamorphic. 39:1 still exists: you crop or use a large sensor.
That is an aspect ratio on spherical glass, not a conversion.
how: Choose a spherical prime or zoom and a stand. Perspective still comes from camera position; 24mm spherical is not 85mm spherical.
Keep the iris in mind if bokeh shape matters: a round iris yields round highlights; a many-bladed iris yields a polygon. No desqueeze in post.
Prompt: Spherical prime on [Subject], round bokeh, rectilinear edges, clean modern capture, no anamorphic streak.
when: Use it when you want control and sharpness over squeeze romance: most coverage, VFX plates, anything that must stitch or track cleanly. Do not label spherical footage anamorphic because you added black bars.
vs: Anamorphic squeezes and often ovalizes. 50mm Normal is a focal length you will often shoot spherical.
Vintage Cine Glass may be spherical glass with older coatings; vintage is not a squeeze. Fisheye is curvilinear spherical or a dedicated projection, still not anamorphic.
examples_film: Most modern digital cinema is spherical unless the production states otherwise. Use that as a reminder: round lamps, no horizontal streak from the taking lens, geometry that matches a prime's field.
The look is the stand and the length, not a flare pack.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is Anamorphic stickers on a round-bokeh image. The tell is letterbox plus circular lamps plus random streaks.
Fix: round bokeh, no squeeze, rectilinear edges, and a named spherical focal length.

faq.a: Spherical lenses capture an unsqueezed image with rotationally symmetric optics. Highlights through a round iris stay round, and there is no anamorphic desqueeze.

Spherical: no squeeze, typically round bokeh, rectilinear field. Anamorphic: squeeze at capture, oval bokeh, often directional flares. Cropping spherical footage to widescreen does not make it anamorphic.
Use it as default glass when you need control, sharpness, or clean plates. Skip it only when the squeeze artifacts themselves are the sentence.

faq.q: How do I prompt spherical for AI image or video?
faq.a: Write: Spherical prime on [Subject], round bokeh, rectilinear edges, clean modern capture, no anamorphic streak. Add a real focal length. Forbid oval bokeh and horizontal flares.
